description.value: Neptune Noodle Bar is a Chinese noodle restaurant on the second floor of Station Square mall in Metrotown, Burnaby, operated by the Neptune Group — a multi-brand restaurant group active across Greater Vancouver. The restaurant offers indoor Chinese noodle dishes within one of Burnaby's busiest transit-connected shopping centres. Cyclists passing through the Metrotown area can order via several major delivery platforms or pick up in person.

bike_parking_detail: 10 racks within 100m: stands (10 spaces) at 54m; stands (10 spaces) at 59m; rack (6 spaces) at 84m; rack (10 spaces) at 87m; stands (3 spaces, covered) at 88m; rack (6 spaces) at 88m; stands (11 spaces, covered) at 95m; shed (50 spaces, covered, secure, paid) at 97m; rack at 98m; rack at 99m. Total: 106 spaces, 50 secure.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms Neptune Noodle Bar at 2nd Floor, 4405 Central Blvd, Burnaby (Station Square, Metrotown) with phone 778-379-0639, matching OSM tags. Delivery platform listings (FanTuan, DoorDash, Skip TheDishes, Uber Eats) on the website confirm takeout availability. No cycling-specific amenities — bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, washrooms — are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Vancouver' but the business is located in Burnaby.
OSM address omits '2nd Floor'; website specifies '2nd Floor-4405 Central Blvd. Burnaby, BC'.
Mall location (Station Square, 2nd floor) may create practical barriers for cycling access and bike parking.
